draft.subject: Photographing Aurora Strings at Carnegie Hall.
draft.body: I photograph performing arts in New York and saw Aurora Strings is performing at Carnegie Hall on March 10. I shoot unobtrusive, no-flash documentary coverage and think it would suit your program. My rate is $250 an hour plus tax, one-hour minimum, with the gallery delivered within two weeks. Recent work is at danwrightphotography.com/music. Let me know how that lands.
